word-emergency.def: a sudden, dangerous situation that needs quick action

word-ambulance.def: a vehicle that takes sick or hurt people to the hospital

word-firefighter.def: a person whose job is to stop burning buildings and rescue people

word-emergency-number.def: the phone number you call to get the police, medics or rescuers quickly

word-emergency-room.def: the part of a hospital that treats people who are badly hurt or suddenly ill

word-first-aid.def: basic medical help given to a hurt person before a doctor arrives

word-first-aid-kit.def: a box with bandages and medicine for treating small injuries

word-unconscious.def: not awake and not able to see, hear or react

word-heart-attack.def: a sudden medical emergency when blood stops flowing to the muscle that pumps blood

word-stroke-medical.def: a sudden medical problem when blood cannot reach part of the brain

word-poisoning.def: an illness or harm caused by swallowing or breathing a harmful substance

word-drown.def: to die because you cannot breathe under water

word-choke.def: to be unable to breathe because something blocks your throat

word-evacuate.def: to move people out of a dangerous place

word-shelter.def: a place that protects you from danger or bad weather

word-fire-extinguisher.def: a metal container that sprays something to stop a flame

word-gas-leak.def: a dangerous escape of fuel from a pipe or tank into the air

word-explosion.def: a sudden, loud and violent burst that can cause damage

word-tsunami.def: a huge sea wave caused by an earthquake under the ocean

word-hurricane.def: a very strong storm with high winds and heavy rain over the ocean

word-avalanche.def: a large mass of snow that slides down a mountain

word-wildfire.def: a big flame that spreads out of control through trees or dry grass

word-theft.def: the crime of taking something that belongs to someone else

word-robbery.def: the crime of taking things from a person or a bank by force or threat

word-burglary.def: the crime of entering a house or building to steal things

word-assault.def: a violent physical attack on a person

word-missing-person.def: someone who has disappeared and cannot be found

word-criminal.def: a person who has broken the law

word-suspect.def: a person the police think may have committed a crime

word-police-report.def: a written record of a crime or accident given to officers

word-siren.def: a loud warning sound used by emergency vehicles

word-helmet.def: a hard hat that protects your head

word-life-jacket.def: a vest that keeps you floating in water

word-panic.def: a sudden, very strong fear that makes you act without thinking

word-weapon.def: an object used to hurt or kill people in a fight

word-harassment.def: repeated, unwanted behavior that bothers or frightens someone

word-stolen.def: taken from the owner without permission

word-lost-adj.def: that you cannot find because you do not know where it is
